name: Real-Debrid sign-in
description: Signs a Real-Debrid account in with a device code, and keeps the token renewed.

codes.realdebrid_auth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at Real-Debrid.
codes.realdebrid_auth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Start it again.
codes.realdebrid_auth.sign_in_refused: Real-Debrid no longer accepts this sign-in. Sign in again.
codes.realdebrid_auth.two_factor: Real-Debrid asked for two-factor authentication. Confirm it there and start the sign-in again.
codes.realdebrid_auth.client_rejected: Real-Debrid did not accept this application. Check the client ID and client secret against the one you registered at real-debrid.com; signing in again without correcting them will not help.
codes.realdebrid_auth.bad_reply: Real-Debrid sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.realdebrid_auth.redirect_unsupported: Real-Debrid signs in with a device code and has no redirect.
codes.realdebrid_auth.client_not_configured: Real-Debrid needs an application of your own. Register one at real-debrid.com under My account → API, then enter its client ID as the username and its client secret as the credential of this account.
